## Observed

The help shown is `ManifestSchema`'s English `.describe()` text (`package-schema.ts` help). The landing copy says "writable base" and "environment overlay" (pinned by `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171`).

## Wanted
A first step that asks only for a name and derives the id and namespace, with the technical fields behind "Advanced", in plain words. Dialog redesign in `ui/packages/app-shell` Studio; if the help wording should change at the source, that is a `packages/spec` describe() change, a seam to name in the PR.
